title: A business park on the site of a Nazi camp

paragraphs: In Austria, the construction of a new business park on the grounds of a former Nazi concentration camp has sparked widespread outrage.
The historic Hirtenberg site, a subcamp of Mauthausen, held around 400 female prisoners during World War II who were forced into slave labor.

Despite archaeological evidence confirming the location’s historical significance, Austria’s Federal Monuments Office decided the surviving physical remains were insufficient for official protection. Consequently, developers have begun building warehouse facilities and a supermarket on the property.

Activists, historians, and memorial organizations strongly oppose the project and say that sacred history is being sacrificed for economic interests. They emphasize that physical evidence of Nazi atrocities must be preserved rather than replaced by modern commercial structures. Although the local developer has offered to fund a memorial, critics say that building over a former concentration camp disrespects the victims and undermines historic memory in a nation that historically struggled to confront its Nazi past.

paragraphs: A new project in Austria is causing anger because workers are building a business park on the site of a former Nazi camp.

During World War II, about 400 women were kept at the Hirtenberg camp and forced to work in a factory. Today, developers are building a supermarket and large storage buildings on this land. Officials said there were not enough old buildings left to legally protect the site, but historians and activists feel sad and angry. They believe that places with dark history should be saved, not used for shopping and business.
The company building the park offered to pay for a small memorial. Even so, many people think that building over a concentration camp forgets the victims and hides important history.

paragraphs: People in Austria are very angry about a new building project. Workers are building a big shop and market on a special piece of land. A Nazi concentration camp stands here long ago.

The company says it will build a special place to remember the women. But many people think that building shops here is wrong. We should remember the past and learn from it.
